products.title: BRAND NEW (NSE6DB870012) Samsung BESPOKE 30" Slide-In Electric Smart Range
products.body_html:
30 Inch Slide-In Electric Smart Range with 5 Elements
Samsung's Smart Electric Range features an integrated Smart Oven Camera that lets you monitor your food closely and make and share time-lapse videos to your social media to show off your culinary skills.* Illuminated Precision Knobs let you know if your cooktop is on from a distance and precisely control your cooktop. This range's Bespoke design with a recessed handle will seamlessly blend into your kitchen for an elegant and minimalist look. This Electric Range features Wi-Fi Connectivity and is voice-enabled, giving you the tools you need to simplify your cooking experience in the kitchen.

products.title: Brand New (Whirlpool) Electric Stove (WFE515S0JB)
products.body_html:
30 Inch Freestanding Electric Range with FlexHeat™ Dual Radiant Element


With the FlexHeat™ dual radiant element you get two elements in one with a 6" inner ring that's great for smaller pots and pans and a 9" expandable outer ring that makes room for larger cookware. Frozen Bake™ technology allows you to skip preheating and cook frozen favorites like pizza and lasagna faster with preprogrammed settings that automatically adjust cooking times for you. Adjustable self-cleaning helps you clean without harsh chemicals or special cleaners by running this high-temperature setting that automatically cleans the oven according to a preprogrammed cycle.

The upswept SpillGuard™ cooktop makes clean up easier with a cooktop that has raised edges to help contain spills. Keep dishes ready to serve while you work on the rest of the meal by using the Keep Warm setting. This setting delivers low heat to the oven to keep prepared dishes from getting cold. Get evenly-baked food with a temperature sensor that monitors oven temperature and adjusts the cooking elements. Closed door broiling maintains the optimal cooking temperature for food while still keeping the kitchen comfortable and cool using this broiling temperature management system that helps prevent overheating.

products.title: Brand New (Whirlpool) Gas Stove (WFG525S0JB)
products.body_html:
30 Inch Freestanding Gas Range with Frozen Bake™ Technology
Skip preheating and cook frozen favorites like pizza and lasagna faster with Frozen Bake™ - pre-programmed settings that automatically adjust cooking times for you. The SpeedHeat™ burner generates 15,000 BTUs, the high heat needed to sear and boil quickly. This unit also comes equipped with an 8,000 BTU center oval burner that can easily fit large griddles and other longer cookware so they heat evenly on the range top. With the upswept SpillGuard™ cooktop, spills are contained by its raised edges and cleanup is a breeze. If you want to get dinner to the table faster with an easy cleanup, then this unit is for you.

products.title: BRAND NEW SAMSUNG (NSE6DG8700SR) 30 Inch Slide-In Electric Smart Range with 5 Elements, 6.3 cu. ft. Convection+ Oven, Express Boil™, Warming Zone, Storage Drawer, Air Fry, Self & Steam Clean, and ADA Compliant: Stainless Steel
products.body_html:
The Samsung BESPOKE NSE6DG8700SR offers advanced cooking technology with elegant design. Featuring a 6.3 cu. ft. Convection+ oven, 5 powerful burners, and Smart Oven Camera, it transforms your kitchen into a connected and versatile cooking space.

Key Features:

  • Bespoke Design: Minimalist, modern style with recessed handle.

  • Smart Oven Camera: Monitor cooking and share time-lapse videos via SmartThings app.

  • Wi-Fi & Voice Control: Works with Alexa, Google Home, and SmartThings.

  • Illuminated Precision Knobs: Easily see when burners are on.

  • 5 Burners + Warming Zone: Includes 3,600W Express Boil and flexible dual/triple elements.

  • 6.3 cu. ft. Convection+ Oven: Bake, roast, air fry, and proof with precision.

  • Air Fry Technology: Healthier meals with no preheat required.

  • Steam & Self Clean: Choose between high heat or steam cleaning.

  • ADA Compliant: Accessible and user-friendly.

Specifications:

  • Dimensions (W x H x D): 29 15/16" x 36 1/4" x 27 7/8"

  • Capacity: 6.3 cu. ft.

  • Cooktop: Smoothtop Ceramic, 5 burners + warming zone

  • Burner Outputs: 3,600W (Express Boil), 3,000W, 1,200W (x2), 100W (warming)

  • Oven Modes: Bake, Convection Bake/Roast, Broil (Low/High), Proof, Keep Warm

  • Connectivity: Wi-Fi, SmartThings app, voice-enabled

  • Finish: Fingerprint Resistant Stainless Steel

products.title: BRAND NEW SAMSUNG STOVE (NE63A6511SS) - 30 Inch Freestanding Electric Smart Range with Air fryer and 5 Smoothtop Elements, 6.3 Cu. Ft. Capacity -  Stainless Steel
products.body_html:
30 Inch Freestanding Electric Smart Range with 5 Smoothtop Elements

Samsung Electric Smart Range offers a total capacity of 6.3 Cubic Feet, 5 smoothtop elements with a rapid boil burner, double ring burner, and warming center. This electric range is Wi-Fi connected and voice-enabled, making it easy to make delicious meals for your family. You can preheat, monitor, and adjust your oven's cooking time and temperature right from your smartphone through the SmartThings app, or control your oven with your favorite virtual assistant, whether it's Bixby, Google Assistant & Amazon Alexa. It also provides a range of convenient features to make cooking and cleaning easier such as powerful convection, No Pre-heat Air Fry, Self + Steam Clean, Hidden Bake Element, Sabbath Mode, Auto Oven Light, Child Safety Lock, and Extra Oven Settings - Bread Proof, Dehydrate, Favorite Cook, Keep Warm.
